outcome: Obstetric characteristics (nulliparity, hypertensive disorders, oligohydramnios, labor induction)
cohort: The study included 44,911 term, singleton deliveries from 2014-2021.
finding: Deliveries complicated by both meconium stained amniotic fluid (MSAF) and small for gestational age (SGA) were associated with a significantly higher rate of adverse obstetric and neonatal outcomes compared to either risk factor alone.
mod_finding: The SGA-MSAF group had significantly higher rates of vacuum extractions and intrapartum cesarean deliveries, including those due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR).
birth_weight: Small for gestational age (SGA) and Appropriate for gestational age (AGA) birthweight categories were included.
gest_age: Term deliveries; groups were defined by Small for gestational age (SGA) and Appropriate for gestational age (AGA).
